answers.text: 'Trend test reads the price, not the long-average order.' My gate is the Trend Template, all eight (C3); the long-average order IS criteria 2-4. W ema_order 9>21 and dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.18 show a short-term up leg at the high, but W hh_hl_3 mixed and ma100 123.87 under ma200 125.57 leave the long stack unrepaired. Price at a high does not confirm stage 2 (C2). Not conceded.

'MA100/MA200 order is not an Elder test.' Agreed, and that is why it is mine: C3 is all-or-nothing and the long stack fails on my declared proxy (ma100 123.87 under ma200 125.57). W close_vs_ema9 above with 9>21 is a tide, not a confirmed stage 2. elder_5d is outside my gate. Not conceded.

'Supply met the break; mid-bar close, no SOS.' Partly my evidence: C5/C6 want the breakout bar to close with conviction on expanding volume. H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 54.7 and H1 last_bar red say the follow-through is not yet shown, though D last_bar green, D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.92 keep price at the pivot and the Template still passes. Not conceded on the name; it moves my timing to WAIT.

'Weekly tide is up, not flat, on my screen.' The tide is not my gate; C3 is all eight Template criteria. W ema_order 9>21 and W hh_hl_3 HH/HL show a base resolving, but ma50 61.27 under ma100 61.75 fails the stack and rs_rank_pct 68.25 is under my leadership floor. elder_5d is outside my method. Not conceded.

'My system reads no 50/100/200 stack.' Mine does, all-or-nothing (C3). D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 1.1 and H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 97.4 put price near a high, but a break inside an unrepaired stack (ma50 61.27 under ma100 61.75) with rs_rank_pct 68.25 is not a stage-2 leader breakout (C2). Not conceded.
